news.headline: Delcath Systems Stock Sets New 52-Week High Near $17.42
news.summary: DCTH shares climbed to a fresh 52-week high of roughly $17.42 as post-earnings momentum from the Q2 beat and raised guidance continued to build. The move extended a rally that began with the August 6 earnings report.

news.headline: Delcath Updates Bylaws to Designate Delaware Courts as Exclusive Forum
news.summary: Delcath's board, on recommendation of its Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee, amended and restated the company's bylaws effective immediately to name Delaware's Court of Chancery (and federal district courts for Securities Act claims) as the exclusive forum for litigation. The change was disclosed via Form 8-K.

news.headline: Wall Street Zen Upgrades Delcath Systems to Buy
news.summary: Wall Street Zen raised its rating on DCTH from Hold to Buy following the company's stronger-than-expected Q2 2026 results. The upgrade added to a wave of positive analyst reaction after earnings.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Raises Delcath Price Target to $32 from $30, Reiterates Buy
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright reiterated its Buy rating and lifted its price target to $32 from $30, citing continued robust HEPZATO KIT demand momentum after the Q2 print. The firm also raised its earnings estimates for the company.

news.headline: Delcath Reports Q2 2026 Revenue of $29.1M, Beats Estimates, Raises Full-Year Guidance
news.summary: Delcath posted Q2 2026 total revenue of $29.1 million (vs. $24.2 million in Q2 2025), including $27.1 million of HEPZATO KIT revenue, with gross margin of 90% and roughly 30% year-over-year HEPZATO volume growth. The company raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M and reported net income of $2.7 million for the quarter.

news.headline: Delcath Doses First Patient in Phase 2 DELUMA Trial of HEPZATO in Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: Delcath announced dosing of the first patient, at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan, in its global Phase 2 DELUMA trial evaluating HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer. The randomized trial plans to enroll about 90 patients across more than 20 sites in the US and Europe.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Delcath's next scheduled quarterly results, which will show whether the accelerating HEPZATO KIT volume and center-activation trends seen in Q1/Q2 2026 continued into Q3.

catalysts.label: Target of 37 active HEPZATO treatment centers
catalysts.detail: Management guided to roughly six additional US center activations by year-end 2026 (from 31 active centers after Q2), a key driver behind the raised $104M-$108M full-year revenue guidance.

catalysts.label: Path to positive adjusted EBITDA for full-year 2026
catalysts.detail: Company guidance points to positive adjusted EBITDA for 2026 as HEPZATO KIT volume, gross margin (90% in Q2), and center count continue to scale.

catalysts.label: DELUMA Phase 2 trial in metastatic breast cancer
catalysts.detail: Randomized ~90-patient trial (HEPZATO + standard of care vs. standard of care alone) in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer began dosing in July 2026 across 20+ US/European sites; a data readout is a future catalyst but no date has been set.

pulse: Delcath is riding strong commercial momentum for HEPZATO KIT: Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1M beat estimates on ~30% volume growth and 90% gross margin, prompting management to raise full-year guidance to $104M-$108M and driving the stock to fresh 52-week highs (~$17.42) alongside a string of analyst upgrades and price-target hikes (H.C. Wainwright to $32, Wall Street Zen to Buy). Beyond the commercial ramp toward 37 active US treatment centers by year-end, the company is also advancing pipeline expansion with the July 2026 dosing of the first patient in its Phase 2 DELUMA trial testing HEPZATO in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer. Near-term watch items are continued center-activation pace, progress toward positive adjusted EBITDA, and the Q3 2026 earnings report later this fall.
